description: Save a named cohort ("book of business") — a list of borrower scenarios you want to track and re-scan over time. Each member has a label and a scenario (product_type, state, intent, amount, term_months, optional credit_score and current_offer). Returns the created cohort. Use scan_portfolio later to re-price every member against the live market.

scenario.description: A financing scenario: { product_type, state, intent, amount, term_months, credit_score?, current_offer?:{rate,apr,amount,term_months} }.

name.description: Cohort name, e.g. "Q2 refi prospects". Required.

name: save_cohort

outputSchema.description: The saved cohort (book of business), as stored. Capped at 50 members.

id.description: Cohort id — pass to scan_portfolio, get_cohort, schedule_digest.

lastScan.description: Previous scan snapshot. Null on a newly created cohort.

label.description: Member label, e.g. the client's name.

scenario.description: The decision inputs for this member.
